style: Warm, natural-light food photography for Frostwell Cakes, a small custom cake studio. Palette of soft cream, rich chocolate brown and raspberry pink. Shallow depth of field, soft shadows, clean uncluttered backgrounds (cream linen, pale wood or matte plaster). Appetising, realistic textures. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signage or watermarks anywhere in the image. If hands appear they must look natural with five fingers.
output: Save each image as WebP in public/images using the file name below, sized for phones (longest side about 1200 px).

images.alt: A tall three-layer chocolate cake with raspberry cream frosting and fresh raspberries on a cream cake stand
images.prompt: Hero photograph of a tall three-layer custom celebration cake on a pale ceramic cake stand. Smooth cream-coloured buttercream with a glossy dark chocolate drip running down the sides, crowned with fresh raspberries, a few chocolate curls and tiny gold leaf flecks. One clean slice removed to reveal moist chocolate sponge layers with raspberry jam and vanilla cream. Soft morning window light from the left, cream linen tablecloth, blurred warm kitchen background in cream and chocolate tones, a small bowl of raspberries out of focus in the foreground. Portrait 4:5 composition with the cake centred and some headroom. No text, no logos, no people.

images.alt: Raspberry chocolate torte with a mirror-glaze top and fresh raspberries
images.prompt: Square overhead-angled (45 degree) photo of a round raspberry chocolate torte with a glossy dark chocolate mirror glaze top, ringed with fresh raspberries and small piped rosettes of pink raspberry buttercream. Sits on a matte cream plate on a pale wooden table, a cake server and a few scattered raspberries beside it. Soft diffused daylight, rich chocolate and raspberry colours, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos, no people.

images.alt: Vanilla bean naked cake layered with cream and mixed summer berries
images.prompt: Square photo of a vanilla bean semi-naked layer cake with visible golden sponge layers, thin swipes of cream buttercream and fillings of whipped vanilla cream and strawberry compote. Topped generously with strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and a sprig of mint. Placed on a white cake stand against a soft cream plaster wall, gentle side lighting, airy and fresh summer feel. No text, no logos, no people.

images.alt: Salted caramel drip cake with chocolate frosting and caramel shards
images.prompt: Square eye-level photo of a tall milk-chocolate frosted cake with a thick glossy salted caramel drip running down the sides, topped with swirls of caramel buttercream, shards of amber caramel brittle, a few flaky sea salt crystals and small chocolate truffles. Warm cosy lighting, dark wood board, cream background softly blurred. Rich brown and golden tones. No text, no logos, no people.

images.alt: Lemon elderflower cake with pale buttercream and edible flowers
images.prompt: Square photo of an elegant two-layer lemon elderflower cake covered in smooth pale ivory buttercream with a delicate textured palette-knife finish, decorated on one side with a crescent of edible flowers (white elderflower clusters, pale pink rose petals, small violas) and thin candied lemon slices. On a cream linen napkin with a light marble surface, bright soft daylight, gentle and romantic mood. No text, no logos, no people.

images.alt: A colourful birthday cake with sprinkles and lit candles
images.prompt: Landscape 3:2 photo of a cheerful round birthday cake with smooth raspberry-pink buttercream, rainbow sprinkles around the base, a ruffled cream buttercream border and six slim lit candles with soft glowing flames. On a cream cake stand at a party table with blurred paper garlands and a few wrapped gifts in cream and chocolate tones in the background. Warm, joyful light. No text, no lettering on the cake, no numbers, no logos, no people.

images.alt: A three-tier ivory wedding cake decorated with blush sugar flowers
images.prompt: Landscape 3:2 photo of an elegant three-tier wedding cake with smooth ivory fondant, subtle pearl details and a cascade of blush-pink and deep raspberry sugar roses with eucalyptus leaves trailing down one side. Standing on a gold-rimmed cake stand at a reception table with soft candlelight and out-of-focus fairy lights and white flowers behind. Romantic, refined, warm tones. No text, no toppers with words, no logos, no people.

images.alt: A large rectangular sheet cake with neat chocolate and cream piping cut into squares at an office event
images.prompt: Landscape 3:2 photo of a large rectangular celebration sheet cake with smooth cream frosting, neat dark chocolate piped borders and a geometric pattern of raspberry and chocolate accents, a few squares already cut and placed on small plates. Set on a light wood table in a bright modern office meeting space with blurred plants and glass walls behind. Clean, professional, inviting. No text, no logos, no branding, no lettering on the cake, no people.

images.alt: A dozen cupcakes with swirled chocolate, vanilla and raspberry frosting
images.prompt: Landscape 3:2 slightly overhead photo of twelve cupcakes arranged in neat rows in a cream kraft box, in brown paper liners, with tall piped swirls of chocolate, vanilla and raspberry buttercream, topped alternately with a fresh raspberry, chocolate shavings and pearl sprinkles. Pale wooden table, soft natural light, a few loose raspberries and a piping bag out of focus at the edge. No text, no logos, no stickers on the box, no people.

images.alt: A styled dessert table with a centrepiece cake, macarons, mini tarts and cake pops
images.prompt: Landscape 3:2 photo of a beautifully styled event dessert table: a two-tier cream and raspberry centrepiece cake in the middle, surrounded by cake stands of pastel pink and chocolate macarons, mini fruit tarts, chocolate-dipped strawberries, cake pops and small glass jars of chocolate mousse. Cream tablecloth, a soft floral garland of pink and white flowers along the front, warm evening event lighting with blurred guests-free background. Abundant, elegant, appetising. No text, no signs, no logos, no people.
